description.value: Pine House Bread & Cake Shop is a local bakery situated on Kingsway in Vancouver's east side. It specializes in bread and cakes, making it a convenient stop for cyclists looking to pick up freshly baked goods along a busy arterial route. The OSM record notes wheelchair accessibility at the premises.
